caption: The drawing depicts a folded woven textile with a geometric pattern. The textile primarily features dark blue as the background color, with accents of red and light blue. The design consists of repeated square and rectangular motifs: large red squares are evenly spaced and connected by thin red lines, forming a grid. Within the grid, there are clusters of smaller, light blue rectangles and squares arranged in symmetrical patterns. Part of the textile is folded, revealing the reverse side, which displays a more varied pattern of red, blue, and pale blue with both vertical and horizontal lines and checkered formations. The composition is centered on the textile, with a plain, light beige background that does not contain any other objects or details.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
